name: product-seo
description: SEO for a product website, judged by signups: triage your Search Console data, fix pages, measure and roll back.

interface.shortDescription: Grow signups from search with your own Search Console data
interface.longDescription: One skill for a product website: sort queries by whether the product is the answer, rewrite pages on positions 8-20, fix titles, clean up and merge thin pages, build task and comparison pages, get listed, and measure every change with a rollback rule.
defaultPrompt: Set up SEO for my site.
Which of our pages are closest to the first page of Google?
The rewrite went live three weeks ago. Did it work?
